en.summary: This commit is a broad tensor-unit collector bring-up and interface expansion change set, not a clean isolated DUT bug-fix suitable for reusable reverse fault injection.
why_it_counts: The primary substance is large-scale operand-collector implementation and interface growth rather than one localized logic repair.
The patch bundles several behavioral additions at once, so there is no single honest portable fault model that matches the whole commit.
disqualifiers: The parent version of VX_opc_unit ends before any operand fetch request generation, operand capture, or dispatch output logic; this commit adds that missing functionality wholesale.
The diff also introduces new register-number helpers, wider operand-id typing, writeback ready semantics, and SIMD redispatch behavior across multiple files.
As a dataset sample for later reinjection, this is closer to feature bring-up on the tensor_unit branch than to a focused bug-fix commit.
evidence: VX_opc_unit.sv gains new request generation, response buffering, pending register tracking, and output dispatch logic that did not exist in the parent file.
VX_writeback_if.sv gains a new ready signal, and VX_operands.sv adds writeback backpressure gating based on pending operand reads.
VX_gpu_pkg.sv adds SRC_OPD_BITS, SRC_OPD_WIDTH, and to_reg_number, which are interface and representation extensions rather than a narrow one-line repair.
The patch spans six DUT files on the tensor_unit branch with multiple distinct behavior changes.

zh.summary: 该提交更像是 tensor_unit 分支上的大规模 collector 补全和接口扩展，而不是适合做可复用反向故障注入的干净、孤立 DUT bug-fix。
why_it_counts: 其主要内容是大范围的操作数收集器实现补全和接口扩展，而不是单个局部逻辑修复。
补丁一次性捆绑了多项行为新增，因此不存在一个既诚实又可移植的单一故障模型来代表整个提交。
disqualifiers: 父版本的 VX_opc_unit 在生成操作数读取请求、缓存操作数响应以及输出 dispatch 逻辑之前就结束了；该提交是整块补上这些功能。
差异还同时引入了新的寄存器编号辅助函数、更宽的操作数 ID 类型、writeback ready 语义，以及按 SIMD 重派发行为。
从后续可重注入的数据集角度看，这更接近 tensor_unit 分支上的功能 bring-up，而不是聚焦的 bug-fix 提交。
evidence: VX_opc_unit.sv 新增了父版本中不存在的请求生成、响应缓存、待处理寄存器跟踪以及输出 dispatch 逻辑。
VX_writeback_if.sv 新增 ready 信号，VX_operands.sv 新增基于待处理读操作数的 writeback 背压门控。
VX_gpu_pkg.sv 新增 SRC_OPD_BITS、SRC_OPD_WIDTH 和 to_reg_number，这些属于接口与表示方式扩展，而不是狭义的一行修复。
该补丁横跨 tensor_unit 分支上的 6 个 DUT 文件，包含多种不同类型的行为修改。
